data.title: Risk-high second integration audit: bn-30fs fbf32fd0
data.description: Second independent STATIC-ONLY integration audit of exact bn-30fs tip fbf32fd0696d43c917bb6f633c35358690a8c232 (tree d486a89354e3d66667f9a466a2d9ce5bb8a9a840), base/merged bn31 tip 192c1ebda91a848b17199da29830cd11c02045ce. Reviewed build_children.py, rustc_workspace_wrapper.py, validate_build_children.py, correctness/overlay changes, merged lock_authority.py, prepare_overlays Cargo-config authority, and bn20 fault API. Focus: subprocess pass_fds and bwrap /proc/self/fd feasibility, ExitStack/fd lifecycle, writable bind selection, wrapper targeting/receipt, materialized manifests, descriptor artifact copies, release proof source, per-build admission, authority/config/toolchain revalidation, and truthful preapproval labeling. Checks were source/diff inspection, exact line tracing, diff hygiene, and one in-memory no-child Python probe of receipt/static-validator acceptance. No edits, Cargo/rustc, build, product/child execution, network, measurement, merge, or cleanup.

data.body: HIGH — the emitted wrapper receipt is not validated as exact targeting/injection evidence. run_build only canonical-parses an object with the receipt schema here; after the build, line 2227 checks only build_nonce. It never exact-sets the nine receipt fields or verifies crate_name=mess_store, package=mess-store, source=crates/mess-store/src/lib.rs, crate_type=lib, injected_arguments equal the reviewed cfg tuple, rustc equal the pinned compiler, or original_argv_sha256 as one lowercase SHA-256. read_bound_regular_file also accepts any non-executable regular-file mode, so the wrapper's required 0444 result is not checked. The static wrapper authority compounds the gap: validate_wrapper requires O_EXCL but never binds  or a post-chmod fstat. Direct in-memory proof without executing a child: changing the wrapper fchmod to 0666 still passed validate_wrapper; a canonical object containing only schema plus the correct nonce passed parse_canonical and the later nonce predicate. Because the receipt root is a writable child bind, post-wrapper code can replace the file and the attestation will publish the forged/minimal object as if it proved exact unit selection and cfg injection. Remediation: exact-set receipt keys and all known values; require exact 0444/nlink=1 identity; require a canonical original argv or otherwise make its digest independently recomputable/format-bound; bind the static validator to exact receipt construction and fchmod/post-fstat; and add hostiles for missing/changed crate/package/source/type/injected args/rustc/argv hash/mode plus post-write replacement.

HIGH — no build-time Cargo configuration authority covers the actual sandbox context or the three Cargo boundaries. validate_lock_authority runs once at line 2050; merged bn31 delegates to prepare_overlays.validate_lock_manifest, which replays each lock candidate's recorded staging cwd, not the effective  cwd created here. run_build performs fresh filesystem-capacity admission but neither captures/replays the sandbox-visible Cargo search nor re-runs the semantic authority immediately before/after this Cargo invocation. The final checks at lines 2251-2264 only re-read cached file snapshots and never replay config search or tooling identity. Consequently source/stage-parent config can differ from the synthetic namespace, and user-owned CARGO_HOME/root config can change after initial validation or between builds to inject rustflags, a wrapper/linker, or source settings while emitted build evidence still passes. The established prepare_overlays build path already shows the required capture + immediate pre/post replay at lines 3003-3008, 3049, and 3058. Remediation: construct and attest an exact config-search authority for every materialized build's namespace-visible cwd/CARGO_HOME/root candidates, including descriptor-stable present files and absence/parent selections; replay immediately before and after every Cargo call; re-run and exact-compare lock/toolchain/tooling authority at those boundaries; preferably bind a frozen config view into bwrap. Add hostile config insertion/mutation/restoration between validation and each of the three builds.

HIGH — Cargo/Rustc consumption is still selected by mutable path even though source, target, wrapper, and receipt are descriptor-bound. validate_lock_manifest hashes the tool paths once (lines 838-843), cargo_environment publishes rustc_path directly at line 1195, and this argv invokes cargo_path directly. inherited_descriptors contains only source/target plus optional wrapper/receipt fds; after all three builds, lines 2251-2256 merely rehash the original tool files. A same-UID process can rename a user-owned rustup toolchain parent aside, install hostile cargo/rustc at the approved paths for a build, then restore the untouched original directory. bwrap resolves the hostile path and can produce arbitrary bound artifacts/receipt, while original file device/inode/mtime/ctime and final hashes all pass. Narrow acceptable remediation: either (preferred) open/hash exact executable descriptors, retain them through the child, execute bwrap via its retained fd, and ro-bind retained cargo/rustc fds at fixed sandbox paths; or retain and pre/post verify the complete canonical directory chain through a demonstrably non-writable trust root, including device/inode/type/mode/nlink/size/mtime/ctime, so swap/restore changes fail the build. Apply this rule to every executed tool. bwrap, git, nm, and Python validator launches share the pathname-selection class; their current /usr/bin placement reduces same-UID exploitability, but that trust must be explicitly validated (ownership and non-writable full chain) or they should also be descriptor-executed. Add a whole-parent cargo/rustc swap, hostile artifact production, and exact restoration hostile.

LOW — expected merged-authority rejection types escape the CLI contract. lock_authority.AuthorityError and prepare_overlays.PreparationError are RuntimeError subclasses and can propagate from validate_authority, live filesystem admission, or MaterializedTreeGuard entry, but this handler catches neither. The operation remains fail-closed and ExitStack still unwinds active guards, yet automation receives a traceback/exit 1 rather than the normalized  diagnostic/exit 2. Wrap exact module-boundary failures as BuildError or catch the imported exact exception types; add rejection-path probes for authority validation, admission, and guard entry.

CORRECTION to shell-stripped literal in the finding: validate_wrapper never requires the exact source operation os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o444), nor a post-chmod fstat. All other finding text is unchanged.
CORRECTION to shell-stripped literal in the finding: the effective sandbox Cargo cwd is /asterism/source. All other finding text is unchanged.
CORRECTION to shell-stripped literal in the finding: the normalized diagnostic contract is build-children: followed by the error, with exit status 2. All other finding text is unchanged.

data.reason: BLOCK exact fbf32fd0696d43c917bb6f633c35358690a8c232: three HIGH integration-authority gaps and one LOW CLI gap. th-1n90xp accepts schema-plus-nonce wrapper receipts without exact targeting/injection/hash/mode validation and the static authority omits 0444 binding. th-xosay4 validates staging Cargo config once but never captures/replays the actual sandbox config immediately around each build. th-12s848 executes Cargo/Rustc via mutable paths, so a user-owned whole-parent swap and restore can substitute tools while final original identities pass. th-3ezsjo leaves merged AuthorityError and PreparationError outside normalized CLI handling. Descriptor-bound source/target/wrapper binds, ExitStack lifecycle, per-build capacity admission, manifests, artifact copying, release proof source, fault API, and preapproval labeling otherwise passed static audit.
